decisive_items: left breast carcinoma diagnosed eleven years earlier
atypical cells were strongly positive for GATA3
response.rationale: The patient's prior breast carcinoma and the GATA3-positive atypical cells within dermal vessels strongly support cutaneous metastasis of breast carcinoma, whereas angiosarcoma would not be GATA3-positive and would instead show CD31-positive tumor cells.

rejected.why: Angiosarcoma is unlikely because the atypical intravascular cells are strongly GATA3-positive, a marker of breast carcinoma, and the patient has a history of breast cancer with prior metastasis.
